afterDeletion.title: What we keep after you delete your account
afterDeletion.body: When you delete your account, we delete your profile, resume files, searches, connections and stored secrets. We keep only a one-way keyed hash of your email address. It can't be turned back into your email, and we use it for one thing only: to avoid giving the free sign-up credits again to a new account with the same email.
